compiled_state.title: [Script Tests/CI]: test-preconditions-validator.sh and test-preconditions-benchmark.sh fail intermittently in CI -> Terminated / empty output
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**Observed behavior:** Two script tests fail consistently in CI but pass locally:

1. `test-preconditions-validator.sh` — hangs and is killed ("Terminated") at Test 5 ("validator exits 2 when auto-locator finds no matching PRECONDITIONS event"). Test 5 creates a temp `tracker_dir` and calls `preconditions-validator.sh` with `TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR` overridden. Appears to hang in the auto-locator path.

2. `test-preconditions-benchmark.sh` — produces no stdout/stderr between its start/end markers in CI; CI reports it as failed with empty output. The benchmark script (`preconditions-benchmark.sh`) does not exist yet (RED test), so the test should exit quickly with a FAIL message — but in CI no output appears.

**Expected behavior:** Both tests pass or fail fast without hanging.

**Frequency:** Consistent — observed failing identically across 3+ consecutive main-branch CI runs (run IDs: 25926539449, 25901510474, 25897158248). Passes in local execution.

**Impact:** Blocks PR auto-merge; obscures real failures since FAILED: 2 always appears in Script Tests summary on main.

**Hypothesis:** Test 5 in `test-preconditions-validator.sh` invokes `preconditions-validator.sh` without a timeout guard. The script may be calling `.claude/scripts/dso ticket` or similar which tries to access git/network state in the CI environment and hangs. The benchmark test empty output may be a related output-capture issue in the CI runner.

**Repro:** Check any recent CI run of the Script Tests job on main — both tests appear in the failed section.

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 4 (INTERMEDIATE) — CI-only hang, moderate complexity, suspected non-determinism
